confirmedNewBugs.title: Canceling mind-map inline editing (Escape or blur with unchanged text) orphans the editor textarea, which remains a live ghost editor bound to node/comment data and can never be closed
confirmedNewBugs.feature: F06 graph inline text; affects authored mind-map nodes AND map comments; NOT file-map nodes (their button is Open note)
repro: 1. Create a mind map file (sidebar New → Mind map). Dblclick a node (or click its ✎ Edit text button). Editor opens pre-filled, focused, text selected.
2. Without changing the text, press Escape (cancel) — or single-click the node (blur).

3. Observed: focus moves to the map canvas (finishInlineMapEdit ran) but the textarea REMAINS in the node card forever. Enter, Escape and blur all no-op afterwards (inlineMapEdit already null; onblur was nulled by finish).

4. Click the orphaned textarea (real mouse) and type (real keys): it is still live — node/comment text mutates in the authored graph in real time and PERSISTS across reload (verified: 'GHOST EHIDIT' survived reload).
5. Same repro on a map comment (open comment editor → Escape → orphaned).
confirmedNewBugs.expected: Escape/Enter/blur closes the inline editor and restores the rendered node card.
confirmedNewBugs.observed: Editor orphaned whenever editing ends with text equal to the card's last-rendered signature; orphan stays live-bound to data.
controls: Enter after typing DIFFERENT text → editor closes correctly and text commits (clean-flow control, passed).
After reload the orphan disappears (DOM rebuilt) but ghost-typed data remains — proving the ghost editor wrote authored data.
Synthetic Escape keydown dispatch on the orphan does nothing (handler present but finishInlineMapEdit no-ops on null inlineMapEdit) — confirms state, not event, is broken.
confirmedNewBugs.sourceMechanism: finishInlineMapEdit (app-js.txt, search 'finishInlineMapEdit(cancel=') sets n.text, nulls inlineMapEdit/onblur, then relies on renderMap() to rebuild the card. renderMap() (search 'function renderMap()') only rebuilds card.innerHTML when JSON.stringify signature [text,file,folder,comment,readmode] differs from card.dataset.signature. When the committed/canceled text equals the last-rendered signature, the rebuild is SKIPPED and the textarea is never removed.
confirmedNewBugs.impact: Stuck editing UI on every cancel/no-change blur; ghost editor silently keeps writing authored data (data-integrity); users cannot tell editing ended; overlaps node interactions.
confirmedNewBugs.fixDirection: In finishInlineMapEdit, explicitly replace the textarea with the rendered .map-node-text span (or clear card.dataset.signature before renderMap) instead of relying on the signature-gated rebuild.
